edits.before: Flash + Teleport standard — TP doubles your shove-tax map game. Ghost-cleanse setups exist into hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport standard — TP turns each crashed wave into a map play. Ghost-cleanse setups exist into hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.

edits.before: - Locke Ritual Nails (Marks): matchup-defining — The nail marks are his whole engine — without 2-3 stacks on you his blink-in barely dents; sidestep the recasts and punish the ten seconds of nothing. Track it before every step-up. - Your spell shield (Iron Boundary): never waste it on chip damage — it is your survival button. - Your ultimate: spend it on kill windows, not on waves.
edits.after: - Locke Ritual Nails (Marks): matchup-defining — The nail marks are his whole engine — without 2-3 stacks on you his blink-in barely dents; sidestep the recasts and punish the ten seconds of nothing. edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: Hold Q for Ashen Pursuit, not the nail poke — silence him as he blinks in and the dash arrives with no follow-up, leaving him stranded in your wave.

edits.before: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: With Void Shift popped and R spent, Ashen Pursuit turns plate greed into a Purgatory execute — back off and reset instead of donating.
